seller_feedback.feedback_text: This order had issues, but the mark of a great seller is when they fix them without delay, and they absolutely did. After I ordered the package arrived fast - but did contain the wrong item. Let them know, and they instantly apologised, sent the right item (fast) and let me keep the wrongly dispatched item (which was actually really helpful) as an apology. Can't ask for more, and would definitely use this seller again.

For a psu of this spec fantastic value. Very well packaged and protected with bubble wrap.  Condition as new. Customer care second to none. Supplier emailed me to apologise that package maybe delayed by a day but in the end it still came on time. He then rang couple of days later to check I had received it and that I was happy with it. Very happy would use again

Items are great and were well packaged, however there was an issue where dispatch took over a week and a number of messages from myself.  Once sorted though there were no issues the responses to queries were quick.

Super seller, kept me informed all throughout. Great value, product works as described. Seller let me see product before committing to buying. Absolutely superb packing and shipping. Would happily deal with again.
Brilliant.  Arrived quickly, very securely packed, had one issue but they immediately resolved it.  Can't ask for more.  Thanks

Drives were priced competitively but the main selling point was the warranty. I also cannot fault the customer aftercare service as I even got a phone call to check everything was okay with my order. Overall a very responsive and fast delivery from a UK based company who I will certainly look to in the future. The hard drives were exactly as described and matched their condition in the photos. The good quality was verified by a SMART test.
Great comms, item well packed and as described, prompt service. Highly recommended
High quality service. Item condition exactly as described. Fast shipping, good packaging. Very good value. Looks brand new, no visible marks from use. Would buy from again.
